how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-searing-gorge-01.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:3181:obj:0: Take Margol's Gigantic Horn to Mountaineer Pebblebitty.⟦1⟧
rows.quest:3181:details:0: The gigantic horn has numerous scratches and cracks. An unusual metal object is lodged into the rough surface.
rows.quest:3181:details:1: BUpon further examination, you notice that the metal is actually a broken axe head. On the metal, the following words are etched:
rows.quest:3181:details:3: BWhen you try and dislodge the broken axe head, it shatters into a million pieces.
rows.quest:3181:completion:0: What have you got there? A fake obviously!
rows.quest:3181:completion:1: BI've been face to face with Margol and I know for a fact that her horn is at least eight times larger than the one you've got in your hands, ⟦2⟧. You probably got that off of a stormsnout in the ⟦E1⟧. No ma'am, you can't fool Pebblebitty!
rows.quest:3367:details:1: BI'm badly injured, ⟦5⟧. Feel... light headed... World spinning... ⟦E3⟧... internally.
rows.quest:3367:details:2: BI must get back to ⟦E2⟧. Help me, ⟦6⟧.⟦7⟧
rows.quest:3367:completion:0: This letter was dropped by Dorius when he was shot.
rows.quest:3368:obj:0: Take the Singed Letter to Thorius in ⟦E2⟧. He is in the Hall of Explorers.
rows.quest:3368:details:1: BIf you are reading this letter, I am no more. How it got to you, I do not know, but thank and reward the ones responsible.
rows.quest:3368:details:2: BAbout the stones: They exist and the Dark Irons have them in their possession. Their leader, Lathoric the Black, is using the power of the stones to enslave my excavation team. They were taken to the cauldron. Their minds are twisted, working night and day to complete something called Obsidion.
rows.quest:3368:details:3: BHelp them, brother. It is the final wish of a dead man.
rows.quest:3368:completion:1: BIn the name of the Light, he will have his wish. This I vow.
rows.quest:3372:obj:0: Find the Mysterious Artifact being guarded by the Twilight's ⟦E4⟧ Idolaters in the northwest quadrant of the ⟦E5⟧ and bring it to the Altar of Suntara in the Slag Pit.⟦10⟧
rows.quest:3372:details:0: Release them, ⟦11⟧. Even after their bodies give out, the power of the Suntara forces them to complete their tasks.
rows.quest:3372:details:1: BThe altar of Suntara is the key. Go northwest; in the hills above the cave... Twilight's ⟦E4⟧ guard a relic. Retrieve it and place it on the altar of Suntara.
rows.quest:3372:completion:0: You place the mysterious artifact on the altar of Suntara.
rows.quest:3377:details:0: Will you assist me, mortal? Hear my tale.
rows.quest:3377:completion:0: I have accepted my fate here in this cage, but the prayer must be found.
rows.quest:3378:obj:0: Find the Prayer to ⟦E6⟧ and take it to Astarii Starseeker in ⟦E7⟧.⟦12⟧
rows.quest:3378:details:0: Will you assist me, mortal? Will you find the prayer to ⟦E6⟧?
rows.quest:3378:details:1: BAs I stated, the prayer was etched onto a golden tablet. One of these idol worshipping scoundrels must have it on their person.
rows.quest:3378:details:2: BIf you do recover my prayer, take it to Astarii Starseeker in ⟦E7⟧. It matters little that my faith has been rekindled after the countless malevolent actions that I have taken against this world and its inhabitants, but my prayer must be heard. Absolution is the last thing I expect.
rows.quest:3378:completion:0: ⟦E6⟧ smiles upon you this eve, ⟦13⟧. You have returned a lost soul to her. Please accept this as a token of our gratitude.
rows.quest:3441:obj:0: Listen as Kalaran Windblade tells his story.
rows.quest:3441:completion:0: Have you heard enough? Are you prepared to act?
rows.quest:3442:obj:0: Collect 4 Hearts of Flame and 4 globes of Golem Oil and return the items to Kalaran Windblade.
rows.quest:3442:details:0: You have made the right decision, ⟦14⟧.
rows.quest:3442:details:1: BWe must strike where we will do the most damage: the four sentry towers.
rows.quest:3442:details:2: BWith the four towers in flames, we can initiate an offensive before they have time to react.
rows.quest:3442:details:3: BYou will need the proper tool to set the towers ablaze. To make the tool requires some materials.
rows.quest:3442:details:4: BBring me four hearts of flame and four golem oil and I shall craft the torch of flawless flame.
rows.quest:3442:details:5: BThe golems and elementals in these lands should be your first target.
rows.quest:3442:completion:0: Well done, ⟦15⟧. We are almost ready.
rows.quest:3443:obj:0: Bring 8 Thorium Plated Daggers to Kalaran Windblade.
rows.quest:3443:details:0: To hold the flawless flame, we will need a shaft and a casing. You must first find a suitable shaft.
rows.quest:3443:details:1: BThe Dark Iron taskmasters and slavers of the cauldron use weapons of enchanted thorium, an extremely sturdy alloy. If you bring me eight thorium plated daggers, I can break the alloy down and reforge a shaft.⟦16⟧
rows.quest:3443:completion:0: You're an exceptional laborer, ⟦17⟧. Have you ever considered a change of vocation? Perhaps a detective? Junk collector? Oh, I know, one of those silly gnomes that crawl across the beaches of ⟦E8⟧ with their metal detecting contraptions, looking for lost treasure. Yes, that would be an ideal position for you.
rows.quest:3452:obj:0: Find and return a Symbol of Ragnaros to Kalaran Windblade.
rows.quest:3452:details:0: We need one final piece to form the torch.
rows.quest:3452:details:1: BIn the mountains to the northwest you will find a large encampment of Twilight's ⟦E4⟧. It is rumored that they carry symbols and idols that pay homage to their god. These symbols and idols could carry sufficient enchantment to form a magical casing. Bring me a single symbol of Ragnaros and I will try to extract the magic from the item to create the casing.
rows.quest:3452:completion:0: The symbol radiates foul magic; perfectly suited for our task.
rows.quest:3453:obj:0: Wait for Kalaran Windblade to complete the Torch of Retribution.⟦18⟧
rows.quest:3453:details:0: Give me a moment to combine the pieces and apply the necessary enchantments.⟦19⟧
rows.quest:3453:completion:0: There is one final task that you must complete.
rows.quest:3454:details:0: The torch must now be bound to its owner. Pick up the torch, ⟦20⟧.
rows.quest:3454:completion:0: You grab the torch with both hands; waves of hatred and anger pulse through your being.
rows.quest:3462:details:0: Speak with my envoy, Squire Maltrake. He will further instruct you as to the use of the Torch of Retribution.
rows.quest:3462:completion:0: Are you prepared to make your strike?
rows.quest:3463:obj:0: Set the North, South, East, and West Sentry Towers on fire by using the Torch of Retribution inside each of the buildings. ⟦21⟧
rows.quest:3463:details:0: Listen well, ⟦22⟧. While the four towers can never be destroyed, you can use the torch of retribution to set them ablaze for a very long period of time: A fire that no element or force can subdue.
rows.quest:3463:details:1: BWhile they are ablaze, no guard or sentry unit can inhabit the watch posts and thus, their first line of defense is nullified.
rows.quest:3463:details:2: BYou must enter each tower and use the Torch of Retribution within their fortifications. Beware the lookouts posted by the Dark Irons, ⟦23⟧.
rows.quest:3463:completion:0: It is glorious! Is it not glorious master?
rows.quest:3481:completion:0: The chest opens at your touch. How much cheese could possibly be in here? There is only one way to find out.
rows.quest:3566:obj:0: Slay Lathoric the Black and Obsidion, and return to Thorius in ⟦E2⟧ with the Head of Lathoric the Black and the Heart of Obsidion.
rows.quest:3566:details:0: It... It... It was all a trap.
rows.quest:3566:details:2: BKill the bastard... Kill him for us... for Thorius.
rows.quest:3566:completion:1: BThis... this cannot be. My own brother? He set this all up?
rows.quest:3566:completion:3: BHe betrayed me, he betrayed ⟦E2⟧! It seems as if the influence of the Old Gods is still strong in these lands. I fear that if my brother - a once noble and honorable man - was so easily turned to the will of Ragnaros, no one is safe.
rows.quest:4449:obj:0: Kill 8 Dark Iron Geologists and bring 15 pieces of Silk Cloth to the person locked in the outhouse in ⟦E5⟧.
rows.quest:4449:details:0: Hey! Hey, you! Get over here!
rows.quest:4449:details:1: BYa gotta help me out. I was runnin' from them Dark Iron dwarves, and I hid in here to get out of sight. Damn bastard geologists and their magic ways! They musta seen me hide, cause next thing I knew, they locked the door and stuck me in here.
rows.quest:4449:details:2: BTeach them geologists a lesson! Oh... an' can ya get me some pieces of ⟦E9⟧ cloth for... for... nothin'.
rows.quest:4449:completion:0: Oh, this is great! Nice feel to it too!
rows.quest:4449:completion:1: BWhat? Oh, yeah... geologists. Got 'em good, did ya? I can't thank ya enough, ⟦25⟧. That'll give me some time to finish up in here... I mean, it'll let me not have to worry about them comin' back for me anytime soon. Thanks again.
rows.quest:4450:obj:0: Take the copy of Goodsteel's Ledger and then find the items listed in it before seeking Krinkle Goodsteel in ⟦E10⟧.
rows.quest:4450:details:0: Oh, you know what? That reminds me.
rows.quest:4450:details:1: BYou wanna finish up a little job I took up while I was in ⟦E10⟧? It's easy...
rows.quest:4450:details:2: BKrinkle Goodsteel in Gadgetzan was lookin' for some stuff found here in ⟦E5⟧ and a few other places. Maybe you could take a look at the list and then bring it all to him?
rows.quest:4450:details:3: BI'll just slide his ledger under the door if you're interested. Take that, and the stuff he wants back to him after ya collected it all.
rows.quest:4450:completion:0: Oh, you've seen fit to do some of the work I requested. Excellent. And here I thought you were going to ask me to craft you something.
rows.quest:4450:completion:1: BThese are all perfect... and everything's here. Thank you, ⟦26⟧.
rows.quest:4450:completion:2: BMaybe it wouldn't hurt to reward you some... hmm, what would you find useful.
rows.quest:4451:obj:0: Search ⟦E5⟧ and find a use for the Grimesilt Outhouse Key you have found.
rows.quest:4451:details:0: The small brass key looks simple enough.. The only thing that seems to make it stand out are some words scratched into the head of it:
rows.quest:4451:details:1: B"Dark Iron Outhouse - Do Not Duplicate."
rows.quest:4451:details:2: BYou have no idea what it means or what it will lead to.
rows.quest:4451:completion:0: Well, I'll be! How in tarnation!? You found the key! I knew them blasted Dark Irons were hiding it after they locked me in here! Thank ya so much, ⟦27⟧. You're the greatest! Now, just turn the key and let ol' Locheed outta here!
rows.quest:7701:obj:0: Deep within the Slag Pit of the Cauldron, in the ⟦E5⟧, you will find the traitorous Dark Iron dwarf named Overseer Maltorius.
rows.quest:7701:obj:1: BSlay Overseer Maltorius and take his head. Return the head to Lookout Captain Lolo Longstriker in the ⟦E5⟧ for your reward.
rows.quest:7701:details:0: By order o' 'is eminence, Overseer Oilfist, the rogue Thorium Brotherhood agent an' newly hired commander o' the Dark Iron Slag Pit crew o' the Cauldron, Overseer Maltorius, is to be killed an' 'is head brung back as proof o' the deed.
rows.quest:7701:details:1: BSee Lookout Captan Lolo Longstriker fer the reward on this bounty.
rows.quest:7701:completion:0: I never thunk I'd be lookin' at thish ugly mug again!
rows.quest:7701:completion:1: BHe acshually looksh better without the resht o' him attached.
rows.quest:7704:obj:0: Take Chambermaid Pillaclencher's Pillow to Evonice Sootsmoker in the ⟦E5⟧.
rows.quest:7704:details:0: Well, well, well... Isn't this a surprise. The Chambermaid had a gigantic ornate pillow and now it's yours. Evonice Sootsmoker will definitely want to get her grubby little hands all over this item. Take it to her and see if she'll offer you any goodies for your trouble.
rows.quest:7704:completion:0: This is better than even I could have thought possible! The Chambermaid's magical pillow is mine! You better believe you're going to get a nice reward for this accomplishment, ⟦29⟧!
rows.quest:7722:obj:0: Somewhere in the Slag Pit of the Cauldron you will find the Secret Plans: Fiery Flux that Overseer Maltorius stole. Find those plans and return them to Master Smith Burninate in the ⟦E5⟧.⟦30⟧
rows.quest:7722:details:0: When that bastard, Maltorius, left our clan, he left with something more valuable than a pristine arcane crystal: Our recipe for fiery flux! I'd bet anything that the recipe was part of the deal in his new promotion amongst the Dark Irons.
rows.quest:7722:details:1: BI want you to get our secret plans back, ⟦31⟧. I'm sure they're somewhere near Maltorius, deep inside the Slag Pit.
rows.quest:7722:completion:0: I hope you kicked his teeth in too, ⟦32⟧. Ragnaros knows, he deserved it.
rows.quest:7722:completion:1: BNow we can get down to business.
rows.quest:7723:obj:0: Hansel Heavyhands wants you to kill 20 Heavy War Golems.
rows.quest:7723:obj:1: BThe Heavy War Golems wander the areas surrounding the Cauldron in the ⟦E5⟧. When you've killed enough, return to Hansel in ⟦E5⟧.
rows.quest:7723:details:0: Unfortunately, I can't dish out the beats like I used to, due to this here fat finger problem. Ye see, the climate out here combined with the lack o' air pressure makes me fingers expand. They're like gigantic Thelsamar Blood Sausages, they are...
rows.quest:7723:details:1: BYe're gonna have to carry out me orders of business and what have ye.
rows.quest:7723:details:2: BFirst on me agenda: Poundin' the livin' daylights out o' the heavy war golems o' the Gorge. Get crackin'.
rows.quest:7723:completion:0: Ye're a good lad, ye are. I got ye a lil' present fer yer troubles.
rows.quest:7724:obj:0: Hansel Heavyhands wants you to kill 20 Greater Lava Spiders in the ⟦E5⟧. You can find Greater Lava Spiders in the plateaus and lava pools of the ⟦E5⟧.
rows.quest:7724:obj:1: BReturn to Hansel Heavyhands in the ⟦E5⟧ when you have killed enough Greater Lava Spiders.
rows.quest:7724:details:0: Wouldn't ye know it, every time ol' Hansel wants to take a moment to relax and reflect upon his life, the powers that be give him another job.
rows.quest:7724:details:1: BMe gots to think, come on! Ye know what I be saying? Come. On.
rows.quest:7724:details:2: BSo, these here greater lava spiders are causin' a ruckus o' some sort. Oilfist says they shoot fire out their... erm, yea well, anyway, such things upset the children.
rows.quest:7724:details:3: BI guess we gots to kill 'em. Rather, ye gots to kill 'em.
rows.quest:7724:completion:1: BI think I'm gettin' a cold. Damn this frigid climate!
rows.quest:7727:obj:0: Hansel Heavyhands wants you to kill 20 Incendosaurs.
rows.quest:7727:obj:1: BYou will find Incendosaurs occupying the lava pools inside the Slag Pit. The Slag Pit can be found in the Cauldron of the ⟦E5⟧.
rows.quest:7727:obj:2: BReturn to Hansel Heavyhands in the ⟦E5⟧ when you have killed enough Incendosaurs.
rows.quest:7727:details:0: Bunions, ⟦34⟧. Me bunions got bunions. How am I supposed to do any sort of killin' with me feet in such disarray? That's why ye're gonna help.
rows.quest:7727:details:1: BScrange and Burninate tasked me to kill these things so they can send some expeditionary teams down into the Slag Pit lava pools to do some explorin'. Supposedly some incendosaurs or some such nonsense down there causin' all kinds o' problems. Now move along an' don't come back 'til the incendosaur population be extinct.
rows.quest:7727:completion:1: BI figured since ye didn't have a luffa...
rows.quest:7728:obj:0: Find and return the Smithing Tuyere and Lookout's Spyglass to Taskmaster Scrange in the ⟦E5⟧.
rows.quest:7728:obj:1: BThe only information you have about these items is the following: They were definitely stolen by Dark Iron dwarves. The Smithing Tuyere is a blacksmithing tool used by blacksmiths and the Lookout's Spyglass is an invaluable monitoring tool to lookouts.
rows.quest:7728:details:0: The following items have been stolen:
rows.quest:7728:details:3: BA reward is being offered to individuals who find and return these pilfered items.
rows.quest:7728:details:4: BThe Thorium Brotherhood is certain that these items were stolen by unscrupulous and jealous Dark Iron dwarves that inhabit the ⟦E5⟧.
rows.quest:7728:details:5: BThe spyglass in question was an excellent tool for the lookouts and the tuyere was an irreplaceable smithing tool.
rows.quest:7728:details:6: BShould you find the missing items, return them to Scrange.
rows.quest:7728:completion:0: Fantastic work! Now for your reward.
rows.quest:7729:obj:0: Slay 15 Dark Iron Taskmasters and 15 Dark Iron Slavers. Return to Taskmaster Scrange in the ⟦E5⟧ once you have accomplished this task.
rows.quest:7729:details:0: Taskmaster Scrange is looking for a few good men and women to help 'cull the competition' in the ⟦E5⟧.
rows.quest:7729:details:1: BIf you are interested in this position, venture out into the ⟦E5⟧ and slaughter every Dark Iron Taskmaster and Dark Iron Slaver that you see.
rows.quest:7729:details:2: BReturn to Taskmaster Scrange when your clothes are bloody enough.
rows.quest:7729:details:3: BYou'll know when they're bloody enough so don't ask.
rows.quest:7729:completion:0: 15.9 pounds! That may be a new record for blood and gut weight on apparel! Congratulations, ⟦35⟧!
